title: happy tony show tuesday #ragtimemusical #joshuahenry #caissielevy #to...
transcript: It’s my favorite day of the year Tony Show Tuesday I always pick a show that I know is going to be special or a performer that I have to see months ago months ago I booked Ragtime for Tony Show Tuesday because I had to be there for Joshua Henry's first show as a Tony winner and I get to be there waited until they announce the extension and then I use my LincTix I jumped on it so fast and I can't wait to go look at that Tonys sign the people called it ragtime we got stickers I'm really excited to be here I keep running into people my first pride playbill too it’s buzzing in here. The energy is so good. End of Act One. We have a standing ovation count of four as soon as they walked on stage everyone stood for the first like 30 seconds standing ovation after the open number standing ovation after Wheels of a Dream standing ovation at the end (after Till We Reach That Day) they're just amazing Joshua Henry is so good Caissie is so good Ben Levi Ross forever Brandon forever I just I love them I love this whole cast i’m not okay so I just wanna say thank you from one dreamer to all of you keep dreaming thank you totally forgot to finish the video but I'm home walking the dog and that was such a special show such a special night to be at I Love Tony Show Tuesday so much the whole cast was on fire the whole audience was on fire there were I believe seven total standing ovations much love by the whole cast for Cassie and Josh at the end I love Broadway. I love theatre kids. So congratulations to Ragtime happy Tony Tuesday happy my Tony winners Josh and Caissie I can't believe it we made it to the end of the season
classificationReason: Creator attended the Ragtime performance (Tony Show Tuesday tradition, LincTix, physically present at the venue), gives clear first-hand opinions about specific performers ('Joshua Henry is so good,' 'Caissie is so good'), and describes the in-theater experience including standing ovations.
